identity.title: Add production birth-witness policy provisioning and invocation boundary

values.summary: Implemented and locally proved Runtime-owned birth-witness trust loading, service provisioning, canonical receipt staging, and fail-closed validation without exposing caller-nominated authority construction.
actual_changes: Made direct authority construction and RuntimeBirthWitnessService provisioning crate-private.
Added an opaque trust object loaded only from the manifest path in validated Runtime credential initialization.
Loaded the trust object during the production adl-runtime-kernel serve bootstrap.
Proved the external production receipt path and all thirteen retained authority, privacy, canonicalization, and rejection cases.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove validated Runtime-init trust loading, canonical production emission, fail-closed preparation, and all thirteen retained security regressions.
Prove warning-free production and test targets for the Runtime kernel.
